retentionUntil.description: Date until which this transaction and its supporting documents are retained. Must be at least the jurisdiction's minimum retention period after postingDate (NL 7y AWR 52 / BW 2:10, DE 8y AO 147 / HGB 257, FR 10y / 6y Code de commerce / LPF, BE 10y BTW, ES 6y / 4y, IT 10y, US 3y/4y/5y/6y/7y).
retentionUntil.title: Retention Until

postingLocked.description: True when the posted entry is locked against in-place editing; corrections are made only by an offsetting reversal entry (immutability / no-deletion principle, GoBD Unveränderbarkeit, §239(3) HGB, §146(4) AO).
postingLocked.title: Posting Locked

periodLocked.description: True when the accounting period of this transaction is closed/locked, so no further postings are made to it without a controlled, logged reopening (period-close integrity).
periodLocked.title: Period Locked

irreversible.description: True when the validated entry has been made irreversible: it can no longer be deleted or modified, only corrected by an offsetting entry (FR PCG art. 911-3/921, NF525 inalterability, FEC validated entries).
irreversible.title: Irreversible

integrityVerified.description: True when the authenticity of origin and integrity of content of the record/invoice are ensured from issue until the end of the storage period (VAT Directive 2006/112/EC art. 233; IT conservazione sostitutiva).
integrityVerified.title: Integrity Verified

archiveAvailable.description: True when an archived copy stays readable, reproducible and available to the tax authority without undue delay (VAT Directive art. 248a; IRS Rev. Proc. 98-25 machine-sensible retrieval).
archiveAvailable.title: Archive Available

saftExportable.description: True when the tax-relevant data of this entry is exportable in a machine-evaluable audit-file format on request (OECD SAF-T, DE GoBD Datenzugriff Z3, FR FEC, PT SAF-T (PT), PL JPK_VAT, RO D406).
saftExportable.title: Saft Exportable

validationDate.description: Date on which the entry was definitively validated (closed), after which it can no longer be modified or deleted (FR FEC validation date; IT conservazione timestamp).
validationDate.title: Validation Date

auditTrail.description: Change audit trail (audit-trail principle / GoBD): every change to the recorded transaction is logged. Each entry carries user, timestamp and action so the full history of the entry is reconstructable.

user.description: The user who made the change.
user.title: User

action.description: The change performed (e.g. post, reverse, correct).
action.title: Action

priorValue.description: The prior value, where the change mutated a field.
priorValue.title: Prior Value

auditTrail.title: Audit Trail
